finding: Repository and live-row records identify source_url value 310 as a legacy numeric source identifier for Tabari entries, not a URL. KSU's Ayat project page credits mosshaf.com as its source for tafsir content, and its S108:3 rendering labels Tabari and displayed p. 602. This traces the displayed witness to the KSU portal and KSU's stated upstream content provider, but neither the legacy ID nor the KSU page identifies the specific print edition, editor, publisher, volume, printing, or source URL behind ID 310. Do not confuse numeric ID 310 with Tabari's death year 310 AH or claim that Mosshaf.com establishes a particular edition.
